title: Two independent faults on the same path
summary: package.json points main at dist/app.js while the build emits dist/index.js, and the configuration reads APP_GREETING while the documented variable is GREETING. Fixing either fault alone leaves the project broken.

checks: the declared entry point exists after the build
GREETING is the variable that is read
the greeting falls back to hello
the undocumented variable is no longer honoured
